title: Bug Report
raw_input:
Bug ID: BUG-202
Title: NullPointerException in PaymentGateway during concurrent checkout
Component: PaymentGateway
Severity: Critical
Environment: Production / Node.js Backend v18
Description:
When multiple users attempt to complete a checkout simultaneously during peak traffic hours,
the PaymentGateway module throws an unhandled NullPointerException while attempting to
retrieve session tokens from the Redis cache. This causes a cascading thread lock and results
in a 504 Gateway Timeout for approximately 15% of active users.
Stack Trace:
java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot read field 'sessionToken' because 'cacheResult' is null
at com.store.payment.PaymentGateway.processTransaction(PaymentGateway.java:142)
at com.store.checkout.CheckoutController.handlePost(CheckoutController.java:88)
at
org.springframework.web.servlet.DispatcherServlet.doDispatch(DispatcherServlet.java:1040)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Simulate 50 concurrent POST requests to /api/v1/checkout.
2. Invalidate Redis cache entry mid-request.
3. Observe crash in PaymentGateway component.
